p: Israel: Read 2Ch 15:17 how by Israel he meant Judah.
slew all his brethren with the: Because the wicked always live in fear, and also are ambitious, they become cruel and spare not to murder them, whom by nature they ought most to cherish and defend.
Israel: Meaning, of Judah and Benjamin.
wife: So that we see how it cannot be that we should join with the wicked and serve God.
Libnah revolt from under his hand: Read 2Ki 8:22.
fornication: Meaning, idolatry because the idolater breaks promise with God as the adulteress does to her husband.
Elijah the prophet: Some think that this was Elisha so called because he had the Spirit in abundance, as had Elijah.
thy bowels fall out by reason: We see this example daily practised on them who fall away from God, and become idolaters and murderers of their brethren.
Ethiopians: There were other Arabians in Africa southward toward Egypt.
Jehoahaz: Called also Ahaziah, as in 2Ch 22:1 or Azariah in 2Ch 22:6.

and departed without being desired: That is, as some write, he was not regarded but deposed for his wickedness and idolatry so that his son reigned 22 years (his father yet living) without honour, and after his father's death he was confirmed to reign still, as in 2Ch 22:2.
